Health insurance- Meuhedet
Greetings Mixers,

I would like to ask if someone has experience with managing health insurance at Meuhedet as wife/husband of Israeli citizen who has insurance at Meuhedet too. My main question is whether you can start the health insurance plan of wife/husband of the Israeli citizen when ever or if it needs to be always on 1. day of the month?

I am trying to get the insurance at Meuhedet since August and we are communicating with very incompetent person who never knows answers and keep giving us wrong information which makes a lot of troubles. Therefore I would like to know whether info that I can start the plan just on 1. day of the month is correct.

Thank you! 🍀
